example_sentences_in_bangla: বাড়িতে নতুন কনেবউ এসেছে, সবাই খুব খুশি।
কনেবউ-কে সাজানোর জন্য অনেক উপহার কিনেছি।
example_sentences_in_english: A new konebou has come to the house, everyone is very happy.
I bought many gifts to adorn the konebou.
note: This is a colloquial term commonly used in rural and semi-urban Bengali contexts to refer affectionately to a recent bride.
